# Wnode Sovereign Compute & Wireless Mesh
> The planetary, RAM-only background compute network monetizing idle consumer hardware with direct Stripe USD payouts and bounded two-tier rev-share.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Invariants
- Stateless RAM-Only Execution: Workloads run in volatile memory sandboxes. Zero disk retention, zero storage wear, zero SSD degradation.
- Direct USD Settlements: 70% of gross compute job spend flows directly to node operators via Stripe Connect. No crypto token volatility or forced Web3 wallets.
- Universal Hardware Access: Runs lightweight native binaries (nodld) across macOS, Linux, and Windows PCs, spare laptops, and edge devices.
- Growth & Partner Lineage: 10% lifetime Sales Source fee for compute customer acquisition; 2-tier bounded overrides (3% L1, 7% L2) for node operator referrals.
